artworks.title: Drapery Study for Reclining Female Study for "Painting"
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper, squared with graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a seated figure. The lower body is completed with detailed shading, while the upper body and head are more loosely sketched. The figure is reclining with legs extended and an arm outstretched to the side. The face has light pencil strokes and long flowing hair. The figure wears a draped garment that covers the lower half of the body. The image includes a staff or rod in the figure's hand. A grid is visible over the image, and there are written text and notations on the right side.

artworks.title: Brownies at Home - Twelve Vignettes
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on twelve pieces of wove paper
artworks.description: This is a series of black and white illustrations featuring whimsical characters in various humorous situations. The drawings show tiny creatures engaging in activities like fishing, dancing, reading signs, and interacting with strange objects. Each scene captures moments of whimsy and satire in a graphic and cartoonish style characterized by strong lines and exaggerated features. The drawings tell individual stories with ironic or humorous undertones, such as reading signs about public events or experiencing physical mishaps. The figures have a playful and spirited energy, creating a lighthearted and entertaining atmosphere.

artworks.title: Hudson River Brick Piers
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a steamship and industrial structures across a body of water. The horizon is low, positioned just above the center of the image. The brushstrokes are soft and delicate, with an impressionistic flair. The color palette is dominated by earthy browns with touches of muted greens, whites, and dusky reds. The scene’s minimalistic approach focuses on the soft lighting and reflections on the water, with a few scattered bright spots suggesting lights in the distance.

artworks.title: Pine Tree
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image portrays a vertical sketch of a single tree, showcasing its trunk, branches, and leafy canopy. The drawing is composed with light pencil strokes, capturing details of the bark and foliage. It features a monochromatic color palette of graphite grey shades on beige paper. Faintly sketched branches and hints of foliage can be seen in the distance, extending the composition.

artworks.title: The Hudson River at Hastings
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from above. The composition includes a wide horizon with hills meeting the sky, separating it from the land. Delicate pencil strokes create a light and airy feeling. The scene features trees and sparse vegetation on a slope leading to a body of water with small vessels like a sailboat. The grayscale palette highlights the natural elements, providing a tranquil visual experience.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Artist's Wife
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman in profile. She is holding a flower in her right hand, with her head slightly turned towards it. She is dressed in light-colored clothing with loose, layered sleeves and her hair is styled in a bun. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man Flailing
artworks.medium: graphite on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing displays two men from head to toe. The man in the forefront is standing with his back facing the viewer, slightly leaning forward while pointing a long rifle upwards. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat and has short hair visible underneath it. His attire consists of a long-sleeved shirt, pants tucked into tall boots, and a belt or sash around his waist. The second man, positioned to the left and slightly behind, is leaning forward with bent knees, holding a rifle pointed towards the ground. He has short hair and is dressed in what seems to be a vest over a shirt and trousers. The setting includes sketchy lines indicating an interior space, possibly with wooden walls. Objects such as a chair with a hat, hanging garments, a barrel, and a bucket are visible on the right. On the ground in the foreground are a dog and miscellaneous objects near the men's feet. The entire scene is sketched in pencil, creating a rough, textured appearance.

artworks.title: The Squatter's Death
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows several people gathered around a bed in a rustic setting. An elderly person lies on the bed, supported by pillows and a blanket. They have white hair and a beard, with their eyes closed. Three other people are also present: a young woman in a dark dress, a young man leaning over the bed, and a younger girl. Another woman is partially visible standing nearby. The background shows a modest room with wooden walls and ceiling beams. A curtain hangs from the ceiling, and a curved sword or large knife is mounted on the wall. A small table with a pitcher and a hanging basket add to the setting.

artworks.title: Aldrich's Dog
artworks.medium: pen and black ink touched with white on buff prepared laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog sitting upright, facing left. The dog wears a spiked collar and holds a leash in its mouth. The dog's short fur is drawn in detailed, dark lines, and it has long ears that hang down and a patch of white fur on its chest. The breed could be something similar to a retriever. The background is mostly plain, tan paper with some simple thin lines.

artworks.title: Foxgloves
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed pencil sketch of two tall foxglove plants with numerous bell-shaped flowers and broad leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of shades of grey. One plant stands to the left side of the image, while the other is slightly shorter and positioned to its right. The largest plant appears to dominate the left and central portions of the composition. The stems and leaves extend upwards with a few taller, delicate stems on the right.

artworks.title: Seated Nude and a Foot
artworks.medium: black and white chalk fixed with water bath on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person with their body turned slightly to the side and legs crossed. Their head is tilted forward and slightly to the side. The sketch features delicately drawn facial features, soft lines for the eyes, nose, and mouth, and wavy hair framing the face. The figure appears nude with fine light-colored lines on a brown background. No clothing, jewelry, or objects are included. The background is plain and minimalist, emphasizing the figure's form and posture.

artworks.title: Jewish Synagogue, N.Y.
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of a building labeled as "Jews Synagogue." The viewpoint is at street level, showing detailed architectural elements. The building's features, such as columns and a spire, are emphasized with linear brushstrokes. Shading and texture are depicted with softer lines. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of grey and black against a light background. In the foreground, an iron fence with decorative arches frames the entrance. Symmetrically aligned doors and pilasters are visible, leading to a tower with gothic-style pinnacles above the entrance. The drawing focuses on the neoclassical architecture's elegance, balance, and symmetry.

artworks.title: White Mountains (?)
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills extending into the distance. There are two large tree stumps in the foreground. In the background, there are mountain ranges and a cluster of wooden structures nestled among trees. The color palette is composed of brown and sepia tones, creating a monochromatic aesthetic. Lighter tones recede into the distance while darker tones are closer, depicting the play between light and shadow in the scene.

artworks.title: Rip Van Winkle
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a man seated on the ground in a reclined position. He has a long beard and hair, wears a long coat, trousers, and boots, and holds a rifle. Next to him on the ground is a pouch. The background shows simple lines indicating trees or rocky terrain.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Artist Asa W. Twitchell
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a man's head and upper shoulders. He is in a three-quarter view, looking slightly to his right. The man has distinct facial features, with deep-set eyes and a full, long beard. His hair is curly and peeks out from underneath a wide-brimmed hat. He wears what appears to be a coat with defined collars. The background is plain, and there are no detailed setting depicted. Below the drawing, the script includes the words "Albany April 13th 1854" and the signature of C. L. Elliott.

artworks.title: Study from a Cast
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a fantastical creature resembling a dragon with a serpentine body, large wings, and a long tail in a dynamic pose. It is carved in bas-relief style against a flat surface, with intricate details and a faintly textured background emphasizing its three-dimensional design. The material is of a lighter shade, resembling either off-white or grey stone.

artworks.title: Sketching from Nature
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink on paper cut into the shape of an arch
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure in a natural setting, reading or writing on a notebook. The figure is placed in a serene forest environment, surrounded by thick foliage and tall trees. The composition reveals intricate details in both the garment worn by the figure and the surrounding rocks and greenery, rendered in fine hatching and cross-hatching techniques. The contrast between the solid form of the figure and the elaborate texture of the forest lends a sense of tranquility and timelessness to the scene. The drawing captures the quiet intimacy of a solitary moment in nature.

artworks.title: Oxen and Dump Cart
artworks.medium: graphite and black crayon with white chalk on  gray wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two oxen pulling a heavy cart up a rocky slope. The image depicts a scene of manual labor, with the oxen yoked together, straining to pull a wooden cart. The cart is heavily laden and has large wooden wheels. The terrain is uneven and rocky, suggesting a challenging path. The backdrop includes rocky outcrops and rugged landscape. The oxen appear focused on their task. The drawing is in monochromatic tones, using graphite or charcoal for depth and detail.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls
artworks.medium: graphite and white gouache on green-gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cascading waterfall near the horizon, with the skyline positioned high above. The scene is depicted using soft brushstrokes to represent water and foliage. The color palette is limited to gray, white, and light earthy tones. On the right, rocky terrain and sparse vegetation are vaguely depicted. The water extends towards the viewer with minor ripples. In the distance, mist from the waterfall blends into the sky.

artworks.title: The Trees, Bedford, New York
artworks.medium: brush and gray and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, clouds, and a small structure visible in the distance. The style of the painting is loose and expressive, using a combination of washes and sharper lines. The color palette consists of earthy browns and greens, creating a sepia-toned atmosphere with varying light and shade intensities.

artworks.title: Study of a Hand
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a hand holding a cylindrical object. The hand is detailed with shading to show the contours and texture of the skin. The fingers are positioned around the object, which is smooth and cylindrical. The drawing highlights the anatomy of the hand and emphasizes its form. Hatching and cross-hatching techniques create a three-dimensional effect. The pencil work is delicate and precise, offering a realistic depiction of the hand holding the object.

artworks.title: Right Hand Holding Short Rod
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hand holding a cylindrical object. The drawing is rendered in pencil with intricate shading and line work to depict a realistic hand with a focus on the fingers and knuckles. The hand is gripping the cylindrical object gently, with attention to detail in the shading to give it a three-dimensional appearance. The background is kept minimal to emphasize the subject.

artworks.title: Right Hand Holding Short Rod
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hand holding a cylindrical object. The image shows a hand wrapped around a smooth, round cylinder. The shading and lines add depth and texture to the depiction of fingers, knuckles, and muscles of the hand. The drawing emphasizes the form and shape of the hand and cylinder with precise line work. The positioning of the fingers looks natural, and there are light and shadow effects on the hand's surface created through hatching techniques.

artworks.title: The Artist's Brother - Richard Greenough (?)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man from the chest up, positioned in profile, facing to the right. He has distinctive facial features with a prominent mustache and focused eyes. His hair is mid-length and falls neatly across his forehead and sides. He is dressed in a coat with a wide collar and underneath wears a striped scarf or cravat around his neck. No jewelry or objects are visible in the drawing. The background is plain and unadorned, with no distinct features apart from the texture of the paper on which the drawing is made.
